Services

Fashion is our specialty. The same planning discipline makes us a strong partner for nearly any event.

Our specialty

Fashion Show Production

Runway shows for boutiques, designers, brands and charity galas: concept to curtain call.

  • Show concept, theme and run-of-show
  • Model casting and coordination
  • Runway, staging, lighting and set design
  • Music, performers and emcee
  • Backstage management and stylist coordination
  • Venue, permits, guest experience and clean-up
